title: Render manifest (idempotency authority + staleness oracle)
description: The git-tracked, versioned render manifest (Design 15 contract #3). It is the spec->doc idempotency authority and the staleness oracle: a record is stale iff renderedGrammarVersion != current Grammar-version OR specHash != hash(the current committed spec) -- a committed, greppable check needing no Lucid round-trip. The reconciler fails closed on a manifestVersion it does not support, mirroring the spec's schemaVersion rejection.

manifestVersion.description: The manifest's own format version (contract #3). A bump preserves read-compat for older records or obligates a manifest migration; the reconciler rejects (fail-closed) a record set whose manifestVersion it does not support.

records.description: One record per rendered instance. specId IS the spec's own id. A composite re-render commits all N records last (all-or-nothing); a composite whose member records carry mixed renderedGrammarVersion is reported inconsistent (requires re-render).

specId.description: The spec's own id; also encoded in the rendered doc as the sentinel shape id `__specid__<specId>` (build-1-probe-verified durable correlation token). Repair matches this token, never the human title.

lucidDocId.description: The Lucid document id this spec renders to (idempotency target). Recorded BEFORE the render is considered done.

renderedGrammarVersion.description: The Grammar-version (house semantics) this doc was rendered from. Staleness predicate term: stale if != current Grammar-version.

renderedSchemaVersion.description: The spec schemaVersion this doc was rendered from. Stamped for completeness; NOT a staleness predicate term (schema drift is covered transitively via specHash).

specHash.description: Hash of the spec SOURCE BYTES as committed (the serialization, computable without re-running stages 1-3). Staleness predicate term: stale if != hash(the current committed spec).
